meta.title: EPBC Act reform: the Streamlined Assessment Pathway (2025)
meta.summary: Worked example (P6): an approval-time cut for investment. The Environment Protection Reform Bill 2025 adds a Streamlined Assessment Pathway that shortens the statutory assessment and approval period for controlled actions by at least 20 days (DCCEEW's low scenario; 141 and 288 days in its medium and high scenarios, if other reforms cut requests for more information). The tool costs it through C2: the delay raises the user cost of the investment that needs approval. DCCEEW's own estimate is a reduction in delay costs of $445 million a year (low), $3,045 million (medium) and $6,914 million (high).

source.description: DCCEEW, Environmental Law Reform: Certification of Final Report of the EPBC Act Review, Addendum to the Final Report (24 September 2025), Table 1 and Methodology, pp. 1–2
